about: What a world costs (Engine v2 O11, #2721): the one unit-price file. Every price has its date and its source; a price with no date is a bug (cost.test.mjs). The machine's own price and size are the owner's to replace with the real machine's (v2/docs/machines.md); until then they are the goal's priced machine.

machine.source: v2/docs/machines.md, 'The goal, priced': dedicated server, 8 cores, 64 GB, from https://www.hetzner.com/dedicated-rootserver/matrix-ax/ (the low end of EUR 79 to 99); disk_gb is assumed until the owner's machine-facts.sh line gives it

split.source: O11's default share of the machine's fixed price by part (#2721); the owner may change it

stored_bytes.source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ (storage A in v2/docs/machines.md; the free 10 GB is not netted out)

uploads.source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ (class A operations; the free million is not netted out)
